commands.gamerule.snowrealmagic.hint: 由於已安裝《雪！真實的魔法！》，此項遊戲規則已被忽略。請移至設定中進行調整
gamerule.snowrealmagic:blizzardFrequency: 暴風雪的觸發機率。每區塊中每遊戲刻有 N/10000 的機率觸發。由《雪！真實的魔法！》模組新增
雪塊將從天而降。可設定 1~8 範圍的最大雪層高度。由《雪！真實的魔法！》模組新增
snowrealmagic.config.accumulation.accumu: 雪會在降雪期間逐漸堆積
雪會在雷暴期間逐漸堆積。（由於靜謐四季模組內的冬季中不會出現雷暴天氣，因此該設定適用於任何會下雨的天氣）
snowrealmagic.config.accumulation.blockS: During snowfall, surface leaves slowly gain snow until reaching the current biome's limit.
Leaves with more snow slowly spread one layer to nearby leaves with less snow.
Chance per random tick (0-100) to attempt snow spreading.
snowrealmagic.config.accumulation.initia: Downfall thresholds (0-1) for initial leaf snow states 1-8. The first value starts state 1, the last starts state 8. Values above the end of the list stay at the last reachable state.
Give surface leaves in snowy biomes an initial snow state based on the biome's precipitation when a chunk is generated.
snowrealmagic.config.accumulation.maxLay: 雪的最大堆積層數。設定為「9」代表無上限
snowrealmagic.config.accumulation.natura: 若積雪超過一層高，將隨著時間融化
snowrealmagic.config.accumulation.smooth: 積雪的堆積及融化過程將會更加平緩自然
snowrealmagic.config.accumulation.snowAn: 雪及冰在溫暖生態域中融化
雪及冰塊會在溫暖型生態域中融化
snowrealmagic.config.accumulation.suppor: Regexes matched against the whole block ID. Matching blocks are excluded even if they match the whitelist.
Regexes matched against the whole block ID. A block must match this list to support snow accumulation.
snowrealmagic.config.accumulation.worldG: World Gen Snow And Freeze Everywhere
The snow and freeze world generation feature will generate snow and ice in all biomes, regardless of the climate.
snowrealmagic.config.fancySnowOnUpperSla: 積雪落在上半磚上時，會同時在半磚側面繪製積雪的外觀變化
snowrealmagic.config.integration.accumul: 若安裝了新增季節機制的模組，則僅有冬天時才會出現積雪堆積
snowrealmagic.config.mobSpawningMaxLayer: 生物可生成的最大積雪層數
snowrealmagic.config.particleThroughLeav: 在積雪的樹葉下方生成雪花粒子
snowrealmagic.config.rightClickToggleFan: 空手並對著部份方塊上方的積雪點擊右鍵，可將積雪的側面外觀切換至更加精細的版本
snowrealmagic.config.sneakSnowball.desc: 潛行並對著積雪點擊右鍵，便可獲得雪球，同時消耗一層積雪
snowrealmagic.config.snow-cover.placeNat: 雪除了能夠被玩家放置於部分方塊以外，還能透過降雪及世界生成等方式自然出現在方塊上
snowrealmagic.config.snow-cover.placeSno: 雪可以被放置在部分方塊上，打造出被雪覆蓋的效果
snowrealmagic.config.snow-cover.replaceW: 替換原版遊戲的地物生成功能，使雪能夠覆蓋於方塊上
snowrealmagic.config.snow-cover.restoreO: 若要解除安裝本模組，可開啟此選項，在區塊載入時將積雪的方塊還原至一般狀態
snowrealmagic.config.snowAlwaysReplaceab: 在雪尚未堆滿整格之前，任何方塊都可以直接放置並替換雪所在的位置
snowrealmagic.config.snowGravity.desc: 雪具有和沙子相同的掉落機制
snowrealmagic.config.snowMakingIce.desc: 掉落的雪塊在接觸到水後，便會轉變成冰
snowrealmagic.config.snowPersistMaxLight: 積雪留存的最大光照等級
積雪不會融化的最大光照等級
snowrealmagic.config.snowReduceFallDamag: 依據積雪的層數，決定掉落於積雪時，所減緩的摔落傷害多寡
snowrealmagic.config.snowSpawnMaxLightLe: 積雪生成最大光照等級
生成積雪的最大光照等級
snowrealmagic.config.snowStepUpMaxIncrea: The maximum step height increase on snow layers or snow-covered blocks, in blocks.
snowrealmagic.config.snowStepUpMultiplie: When walking on snow layers or snow-covered blocks, the step height of players and their controlled creatures increases by this multiple of the base step height. 1 means doubled.
snowrealmagic.config.snowVariants.desc: 部分覆雪的植物會以不同的樣貌呈現
snowrealmagic.config.sustainGrassIfLayer: 當積雪高度超過 1 層高時，可阻止草地變為泥土
snowrealmagic.config.visual.snowyLeavesB: How much the original leaf texture's brightness controls the snow opacity. 0 ignores brightness; 100 makes bright pixels fully covered and dark pixels use the minimum opacity.
snowrealmagic.config.visual.snowyLeavesI: The lowest visual snow intensity applied to leaves. Actual snow accumulates per block; this value only raises the minimum visual coverage. 0 disables the minimum.
snowrealmagic.config.visual.snowyLeavesM: Minimum snow opacity for the darkest leaf pixels at full intensity. 0 lets dark pixels stay fully clear; 100 covers everything uniformly.
snowrealmagic.config.visual.snowyLeavesS: How strongly the snow fades from the top to the bottom of the side faces. 0 makes the sides uniform; 100 fades to fully clear at the bottom.
Maximum number of opacity steps in the side gradient. 1 makes the sides uniform; higher values allow more steps.
Boosts the snow opacity at the top of the side faces when the intensity is low. 0 uses a linear curve; 100 uses a square-root curve.
Visual snow intensity for each leaf snow state, from state 0 to 8. Values outside 0-100 are clamped. The minimum intensity above still applies.
